export const API_BASE_URL=(process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:8000').replace(/\/$/,'');/**
 * Build a full image URL from a path like /uploads/testimonials/uuid.jpg
 * Returns a default placeholder if the path is falsy.
 */export const getImageUrl=function(path){let placeholder=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:'/default-avatar.png';if(!path)return placeholder;const value=String(path).trim();if(value.startsWith('http://')||value.startsWith('https://')||value.startsWith('blob:')||value.startsWith('data:')){return value;}const normalizedPath=value.startsWith('/')?value:"/".concat(value);return"".concat(API_BASE_URL).concat(normalizedPath);};
